snippet.title: TORNBLADE — Official Teaser | Dark Indie Action RPG
snippet.description:
A dark, brutal indie action RPG inspired by the classic games of the 80's and 90's, shaped by Slavic and Celtic myth.

A lone knight wandering through a dying land.
A world collapsing into silence and rot.
This is the beginning of the journey into Tornblade.

Wishlist on Steam:
